question: Which year was designated by UNESCO as the International Year of the Periodic Table (IYPT) to mark the 150th anniversary of the Mendeleev Periodic Table?
solution:
The correct answer is **__2019.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• One of science's greatest accomplishments, the **Periodic Table **of **Chemical **Elements captures the core of not only chemistry but also physics and biology.
 
• It is a special tool that enables scientists to **forecast **the **characteristics **of **matter **on **Earth **and throughout the rest of the universe.
 
• The Periodic Table of Chemical Elements is more than just a reference or list of all the known **atoms **in the universe; it serves as a window on the **cosmos **and aids in deepening our comprehension of the environment.
 
• The **150th anniversary **of its invention by Russian scientist Dmitry Ivanovich Mendeleev occurs in the **year 2019**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The **chemical elements **are arranged in **rows **and **columns **on what is known as the periodic table, or periodic table of the (chemical) elements.
 
• It is frequently used in chemistry, physics, and other sciences and is frequently regarded as a **symbol **of **chemistry**.
 
• It is visual representation of periodic law, which claims that the **atomic numbers **of chemical elements have a roughly periodic relationship with their attributes.
 
• The table is divided into **four blocks **that are rectangular in shape.
 
• The table's **columns **are referred as **groups **and its **rows **are known as **periods**.
 
• The periodic table's **elements **in **same group **have comparable chemical properties.
